messages:
DeployBot: FYI starting schema run `mig_922_fanout` in 45m; targets: us-east-1, eu-central-1. Strategy: tenant-group waves, adaptive row cap, checkpoints after each wave. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig_922
Kelsey Ortiz: Quick Q: will this change require a code rollout for validators?
Amit Rao: We only add `external_id` NULLable now. Validation (NOT NULL) will be separate deploy next week. No validator change required, but we'll pin just in case.
Erin Blake (oncall): If p95 queries jump >200ms for 3m I'll hit pause. Please confirm who pauses and what signals look like.
Tobias Meyer: /deploybot pause and /deploybot abort are gated to oncall and release leads. Pause will stop new waves; abort will run rollback to last checkpoint.
Kelsey Ortiz: Proposed safety knobs: ROW_CAP=150k, WAVE_SLEEP_MS=12000, RETRY=2. Agree?
Amit Rao: Agree. Also add a soft-limit that slows workers if read qps > X. I'll add a quick config.
Erin Blake (oncall): I'll be watching read-replica lag, p95, and error rate. If any signal crosses threshold I'll post `:pause:` here. Also will annotate metrics with the thread id.
DeployBot: Preflight checklist: (1) service pinned to api-service@v2.14.3 during validate window, (2) ROW_CAP set, (3) monitor dash ready, (4) oncall present.
Kelsey Ortiz: I'll pin api-service@v2.14.3 now for the 2h window post-backfill.
Amit Rao: Preflight snippet: ```sh
# sanity
psql -c "select now(), pg_is_in_recovery(), pg_stat_replication.* from pg_stat_replication limit 1;"
# replica lag < 30s required
```
Tobias Meyer: Checkpoints will be named `mig_922_cp_{wave}` and stored in migrations table. Rollback will restore tombstones + requeue tenants that failed.
DeployBot: 15m reminder. Auto-checkpoint after each wave. Abort will require manual approval from release lead after fail-fast checks.
Erin Blake (oncall): I'm at desk. I'll escalate immediately if needed. Keep replies concise. :eyes:
Kelsey Ortiz: Starting wave1 in 5m. ROW_CAP=150k, RETRY=2 set.
DeployBot: wave=1 started tenants=95 target_rows=150000 checkpoint=mig_922_cp_1.
Amit Rao: wave1 looks clean; p95 stable.
DeployBot: wave=2 started. tenants=110 checkpoint=mig_922_cp_2.
Tobias Meyer: saw a transient timeout on tenant 202 in wave2; automated retry kicked, monitoring tail latencies.
Erin Blake (oncall): No pause. tail p95 spike but fell back under threshold.
DeployBot: wave=3 started. tenants=130.
Kelsey Ortiz: wave3 mid-run: small uptick in replica lag in eu-central-1 to ~28s. still under 30s.
Amit Rao: bumped worker backpressure threshold to reduce write bursts.
DeployBot: wave=3 completed; checkpoint mig_922_cp_3 created. finalizing.
Kelsey Ortiz: migration finished. final checkpoint mig_922_cp_final created. scheduling async NOT NULL validate in 24h.
Erin Blake (oncall): Marking monitoring ok. No pause/abort. Good job team. :tada:
Tobias Meyer: Adding release notes blurb: "Added nullable external_id with staged backfill (waves, ROW_CAP=150k). Pinned api-service@v2.14.3 during validate window."
Kelsey Ortiz: Will open PR for follow-up NOT NULL validate deploy next week.
DeployBot: Thread closed for ops. If rollback required, reopen this thread and run `/deploybot rollback mig_922 --to-checkpoint mig_922_cp_{n}`.
